findings.claim: Across the full observed score window [0.0, 0.49], landmark_00_local_dx shows a non-monotone profile: it rises to a positive peak near t≈0.10-0.11, then falls to a negative trough near t≈0.19, and returns toward small positive values by t≈0.49. The whole-window mean is slightly negative (whole_window_z≈-0.18) and the polynomial fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.78, 6 sign changes, 9 strong sign conflicts), so the shape is a changing contrast rather than a stationary target.

landmark_00_local_dy is predominantly negative over the window, with the most negative values early (t≈0.02-0.05) and a partial recovery toward zero after t≈0.13; whole_window_z≈-0.30. The linear fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.67, 6 sign changes, 4 strong sign conflicts), so the early-to-late change is not a clean monotone trend.

landmark_00_local_dz is near zero on average (whole_window_z≈-0.02) but has a pronounced early positive excursion (t≈0.04-0.05) followed by a late negative drift (t≈0.44-0.49); the cubic fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.72, 10 sign changes, 7 strong sign conflicts).

landmark_00_soft_mass is the most coherent of the read features: it rises from negative early values to a positive plateau around t≈0.14-0.30, then declines toward slightly negative values by t≈0.49, with whole_window_z≈0.64 and the lowest relative_node_RMSE among the read features (≈0.29, 4 sign changes, 1 strong sign conflict).

landmark_01_local_dx and landmark_01_local_dy both show early positive-to-negative transitions: dx peaks near t≈0.05 then falls to a trough near t≈0.15-0.19 before recovering; dy is mostly negative with a late recovery. Both have whole-window means near zero (dx≈-0.22, dy≈-0.50) and non-accepted polynomial fits.

landmark_01_local_dz has a strong early negative excursion (t≈0.01-0.05) followed by a positive peak near t≈0.15 and return toward zero; whole_window_z≈-0.01. landmark_01_soft_mass is mostly negative with a late rise toward zero; whole_window_z≈-0.25. Neither polynomial fit was accepted.

hypotheses.direction: time-varying curvature rather than fixed coordinate target
hypotheses.falsifier: If the landmark_00_local_dx profile is stationary or monotone across the window in a re-read, the time-varying-curvature rationale is not supported.
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate contrast changes sign across the observed window (positive near t≈0.10, negative near t≈0.19), so a reward that treats this coordinate as a fixed target would be inconsistent with the observed trajectory. A temporal reward schedule that modulates curvature (delta) over the observed score nodes, rather than imposing a constant coordinate target, is the supported direction for this feature.

hypotheses.direction: time-varying curvature keyed to the observed rise-then-fall profile
hypotheses.falsifier: If landmark_00_soft_mass is flat or its profile is not reproducible across independent batches, the schedule rationale is not supported.
hypotheses.statement: landmark_00_soft_mass shows a coherent rise-then-fall profile with the lowest relative node RMSE among the read features, making it the most suitable observable for a temporal reward schedule that changes curvature over the observed window.

hypotheses.direction: time-varying curvature rather than fixed coordinate target
hypotheses.falsifier: If either feature is stationary or monotone across the window in a re-read, the time-varying-curvature rationale is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_dz (predicted endpoint world-A coordinates)
hypotheses.statement: landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_dz both show early-to-late sign changes with non-accepted polynomial fits, so a constant-coordinate reward for these features would conflict with the observed temporal contrast; a schedule that varies curvature over the window is the supported direction.

limitations: Only 8 of 200 curve features were read; the remaining landmark coordinates (cxx, cxy, cxz, cyy, cyz, czz) and landmarks 02-19 were not observed, so no claim is made about them.
No stage profiles or temporal profiles are available; all evidence is from continuous curves over the observed score window [0.0, 0.49].
Polynomial fits were not accepted for any read feature (relative_node_RMSE 0.29-0.78, multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts), so no smooth global trend is asserted.
Selection preference and coordinate contrasts are associations, not measured descendant survival or final affinity benefit; no decoded affinity labels are present in this input.
The registered temporal recipes (C1, C2, C3) are reward-route curvature schedules; no dose or combined-lane evidence is available in this input.
